name: Gilat Telecom Global Ltd
summary: Gilat Telecom Global Ltd, established in 1968 as Satcom Systems Ltd and based in Petach Tikva, Israel, delivers a comprehensive array of communication services. The company utilizes satellite, fiber optic, and radio system infrastructures to provide solutions both domestically in Israel and across international markets. Its primary offerings encompass various data communication services, including establishing and managing internet network connections, setting up and operating internal corporate data networks, and overseeing the communication infrastructure for internet service providers and mobile operators. Gilat Telecom also provides expert consulting and network design for fiber and satellite-based communication solutions, which covers equipment sales, installation, ongoing maintenance, and operational support. Furthermore, it specializes in mobile satellite communication, offering a complete spectrum of services from initial consultation and planning to equipment supply, project execution, system operation, and the provision of data and telephony services. The company additionally provides broadband connectivity and advanced communication solutions. Its diverse client base includes internet service providers, various institutions, community organizations, and military and security entities.
